title: {{NAME}} and the Lost Unicorn Foal
moral: If you are gentle and patient, you can earn the trust of anyone.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked into the Glitter Woods one afternoon. The trees sparkled with fairy dust. Rainbow mushrooms grew on every side. Then {{NAME}} saw something small hiding behind a tree. It had a tiny silver horn. It was a baby unicorn, all alone.
